StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Authenticated student learning profile and cumulative pronunciation growth summary.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

username.description: Normalized login username of the student.

displayName.description: Student full name displayed on profile and progress reports.

targetLevel.description: Student's current CEFR Turkish target level.

role.description: Account role; client registration always enforces student.

totalAttempts.description: Total number of recorded speech activities completed.

firstScore.description: Accuracy score (0-100) from the student's very first activity.

latestScore.description: Accuracy score (0-100) from the most recent activity.

bestScore.description: Highest accuracy score (0-100) achieved so far.

growthDelta.description: Point improvement between the first activity score and recent performance (-100 to 100).

perfectWordsCount.description: Total number of perfectly pronounced Turkish words.

firstActivityAt.description: ISO timestamp of the first recorded activity, or empty string before first activity.

lastActivityAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent activity, or empty string before first activity.

unlockedLevelOrder.description: Highest unlocked level order (1-50) in the Duolingo-style diction curriculum; starts at 1 (A vowel).

completedLevelIds.description: List of completed diction level IDs (max 50) that can be freely revisited and repeated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was last updated.

StudentActivity.title: StudentActivity
StudentActivity.description: Immutable record of a single Turkish pronunciation and diction practice attempt.

activityId.description: Unique document ID for this activity.

attemptNumber.description: Sequential 1-based attempt number from the student's very first activity.

activityType.description: Category of the Turkish learning activity.

contextTitle.description: Title of the dialogue, diction rule, or practice context.

wordsPerMinute.description: Estimated speaking rate in words per minute (0-400).

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the voice recording in seconds (0-600).

perfectWords.description: Number of words pronounced with >=85% similarity.

totalWords.description: Total target word count in the sentence.

problemPhonemes.description: List of up to 10 Turkish phonemes needing diction attention.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this activity was saved.

/students/{studentId}.description: Per-student profile document with cumulative growth metrics from first activity onward.

/students/{studentId}/activities/{activi.description: Immutable chronological log of every pronunciation and diction activity completed by a student.
